text: Two men, one test. One said: I earned it... and the earth swallowed him. What would you say?
Qarun was from the people of Musa, alayhis salaam. Allah gave him treasures whose keys would burden a band of strong men.
His people told him: do not exult. Allah does not like the exultant.
He said: I was only given it because of knowledge I have.
Prophet Sulaiman, alayhis salaam, was given far more: the wind, the jinn, a kingdom like no other.
And when a queen's throne was placed before him in a blink, he said: This is from the favor of my Lord, to test me whether I will be grateful or ungrateful.
About Qarun, Allah says: And We caused the earth to swallow him and his home.
And about Sulaiman: An excellent servant. Indeed, he was one repeatedly turning back to Allah.
Whatever you have today is the same test. Pass it the way Sulaiman did: this is from the favor of my Lord.
